roleContext.jobDescription: The payments operations team of a regional bank processes outgoing and incoming payments, investigates exceptions and runs the month-end processing calendar. The analyst works the exception queues, reconciles the nostro accounts each morning, prepares the daily cut-off report and covers the month-end processing rota, which includes one Saturday session in most months. The team of 11 analysts reports to the payments operations manager and works from the bank's processing centre. Outgoing payments run through SWIFT and the national faster-payments scheme, and nostro balances are reconciled each morning before the funding call. The month-end rota is published a quarter in advance and follows the bank's cut-off timetable for each currency.

requirements.text: Investigates and clears payment exceptions within the service-level times.
Covers the month-end processing rota, including Saturday sessions in most months.
Reconciles nostro accounts daily and escalates unmatched items over the threshold.
Prepares the daily cut-off report for the payments operations manager.
Repairs SWIFT MT103 and MT202 payment messages.

candidate.originalCvMarkdown:
# Curriculum vitae

Target role: Payments Operations Analyst

## Experience

- Cleared exceptions in the outgoing SWIFT queue at Harrowgate Building Society, repairing or returning about 60 payments a day within the internal service-level times.
- Reconciled four nostro accounts each morning in SmartStream TLM and escalated unmatched items above £10,000 to the team leader before 11:00.
- Prepared the daily cut-off report showing payments sent, payments held and items queued for the next value date, sent to the payments operations manager at close.
- Read and repaired MT103 customer transfers and MT202 bank-to-bank transfers, correcting beneficiary and intermediary details against the standing settlement instructions.
- Worked weekday month-end processing for the retail payments queues.

## Work samples

- Work sample: an anonymised daily cut-off report for one business day, with the counts of payments sent and held, the items queued for the next value date and that day's exceptions log.
